verses.text: 12. The same abba said, ‘The righteous sin through their mouth, but the ungodly sin in their whole bodies. This is why David sings; “Set, O Lord, a watch before my mouth and keep the door of my lips.” (Ps. 141,3) And again, “I will take heed to my ways that I do not sin with my tongue.” ’ (Ps. 39.1)
